shell_options.description: List of shopt options to enable or disable (e.g., cdspell, dirspell, histappend). Valid names per bash(1) shopt builtin documentation are required. Each item must contain 'name' and 'enabled'.

set_options.description: List of 'set' shell attributes to enable or disable (e.g., errexit, nounset, pipefail). Each item must contain 'name' and 'enabled'.

aliases.description: List of alias definitions. Each item must contain 'name' and 'value'.

functions.description: List of shell function definitions. Each item must contain 'name' and optionally 'body' (multi-line string).

read_keybindings.description: List of readline keybindings. Each item may contain 'keyseq' (e.g., '"\C-x\C-r"'), and 'function' (e.g., 're-read-init-file').

export_vars.description: List of shell variables to export. Each item must contain 'name', and optionally 'value'.

readonly_vars.description: List of shell variables to mark readonly. Each item must contain 'name', and optionally 'value'.
